home.heroTitle: We design it, we build it, we race it
home.heroLead: We are the ISC Formula Student Racing Team: more than 80 students from Universidad Pontificia Comillas who conceive, build and compete with an electric single-seater made from scratch. Nine seasons, eight prototypes and one clear ambition — to belong among the best in Europe.
home.eventsLead: The year opens with member selection and closes on track. These are the dates that shape the 2026/2027 season.
home.joinLead: We are looking for undergraduate and master's students at Comillas ICAI ready to take real responsibility: parts that get manufactured, deadlines that do not move, and a car that has to run in August.

joinPoints.text: Real technical work from your first month, inside one of the team's five verticals.
A professional structure: reports, design reviews, cost control and supplier management.
International competition with the team, in Austria and Spain.

team.heroTitle: Over 80 students. Five verticals. One single-seater.
team.introTitle: A team organised like an engineering company
team.intro1: The ISC FS Racing Team is made up of more than 80 undergraduate and master's students from Industrial Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Business Analytics and Business Administration.
team.intro2: Organisationally the team has a Team Leader responsible for the season's overall strategy and objectives, covering technical, financial and communication matters. The Technical Directors carry the specialisation by area: they verify every technical decision in detail and supervise each department's progress.
team.leadLead: Project management and the cross-functional areas hold the season together; the technical directors answer for the car.

techLeads.name: Miguel Ángel Medina Lazcano · Fernando Mª Tobar Pérez

team.vertLead: Each vertical groups the departments that share a technical interface, and every department has a lead accountable to their director.
team.photoNote: Member portraits to be replaced with the official season photography.

verticals.name: Mechanical
verticals.blurb: Chassis, aerodynamics, suspension and everything that turns power into lap time. The largest vertical on the team.

depts.name: Suspension & Dynamics
depts.lead: Ignacio Ramos Villar · Rodrigo García Diéguez

verticals.name: Tractive System
verticals.blurb: The high-voltage driveline: accumulator, cell cooling, inverters and electrical safety.

verticals.name: Electronics
verticals.blurb: Control electronics, on-board subsystems and telemetry. Without data there are no decisions.

verticals.name: Driverless
verticals.blurb: Perception, SLAM, path planning and control. We lead the first autonomous Formula Student effort in Madrid.

verticals.name: Statics
verticals.blurb: The static events carry 325 of the 1,000 points: design, cost and business plan are prepared all year round.

comp.heroTitle: A thousand points, eight events, one car.
comp.what1: Formula Student is an international competition that brings together the best engineering schools and challenges teams made up exclusively of students to conceive, design, manufacture and compete with an electric single-seater built from scratch.
comp.what2: In Spain, Formula Student takes place every August at the iconic Circuit de Montmeló in Barcelona. The competition is divided into two distinct parts: static events and dynamic events.
comp.what3: Between them, teams must pass technical inspections with over a thousand compliance items. Only the cars that clear them are allowed to run.
comp.staticLead: Engineering judgement is what gets scored, not just the result: why it is designed this way, what it costs to manufacture, and whether the project stands up as a business.

staticEvents.name: Engineering Design
staticEvents.desc: Design defence in front of industry judges: decisions, simulation, validation and traceability for every technical choice.

staticEvents.name: Cost & Manufacturing
staticEvents.desc: The real cost of the car part by part, manufacturing processes and the economic case for every component.

staticEvents.name: Business Plan
staticEvents.desc: The project presented as a business opportunity to an investor panel. Second place in 2021, a podium in 2024.

comp.dynLead: Five events that push the car to its limit: top speed, cornering stability, reliability, efficiency and range.

dynEvents.name: Acceleration
dynEvents.desc: 75 metres in a straight line from standstill. Traction, torque control and load transfer.

dynEvents.name: Skidpad
dynEvents.desc: A constant-radius figure of eight. It measures lateral balance and weight distribution.

dynEvents.name: Autocross
dynEvents.desc: A single fast lap on a cone course. It sets the endurance starting order.

dynEvents.name: Endurance
dynEvents.desc: 22 kilometres with a driver change. The highest-scoring event, and the one that breaks the most cars.

dynEvents.name: Efficiency
dynEvents.desc: Energy consumed against lap time. It rewards how well the accumulator is managed.

comp.tableNote: Reference breakdown from the Formula Student rules for the electric category.
comp.scrutTitle: Before you run, you pass inspection
comp.scrutText: Mechanical and electrical inspection, tilt test, brake test and rain test. It is the filter that keeps half the grid out of the dynamic events. ISC has cleared it five seasons in a row.

spon.heroLead: We look for experienced companies that share the same drive for innovation and see the project for what it is: a pool of talent and initiative among young engineers about to enter working life.
spon.whyLead: Because of its international character, Formula Student is the perfect showroom for any company that recognises the potential of engineering and youth combined.

why.title: Young talent
why.text: Our members work inside a structure much like the one they will find in their first job: reports, deadlines, processes, documentation and, above all, responsibility.

why.title: Innovation in electric mobility
why.text: The team trains and innovates in the electrical systems taking over the mobility industry. Members acquire the specific knowledge needed to work in electric vehicle ecosystems.

why.title: Innovation in autonomous driving
why.text: We are leading the first efforts to implement autonomous electric systems within Formula Student in Madrid, preparing our members for real autonomous mobility environments.

why.title: Spanish engineering in Europe
why.text: Support for Spanish engineers and Spanish universities on the European and international stage, competing at the benchmark events of the electric category.

partners.title: Finance Partner
partners.text: Provides financial support to the team and backs specific lines of research within the project.

partners.title: Fabrication Partner
partners.text: Supplies parts and components, or helps manufacture elements of the car.

partners.title: Logistics Partner
partners.text: Provides means for the team: vehicle transport, member travel, tooling, workshop material or audiovisual support.

spon.wallLead: We look for long-term agreements in which both parties make the most of the project's potential and of its members.
